title: Who’s News: Strategic Appointments at Quantum eMotion, Pasqal, Royal Bank of Canada, and 01 Quantum Inc. - Quantum Computing Report
gist: Quantum appointments: Quantum eMotion added ex-Certicom CEO Bernard Crotty to its board, Pasqal (now NASDAQ: PSQL) hired a Chief Legal Officer, RBC created a quantum strategy team under Dr. Elizabeth Iwasawa, and 01 Quantum named a new CFO. The hires point to public-company maturation and bank and PQC build-outs.

themes.theme: Quantum companies professionalizing for public markets

insights.claim: Pasqal appointed Florence Lao, formerly General Counsel at Deezer, as Chief Legal Officer effective October 1, 2026, to oversee securities compliance, IP and governance as a publicly traded company.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Pasqal is a listed quantum-hardware name (PSQL); a securities-focused legal hire signals investor-facing build-out.

insights.claim: 01 Quantum named Jeffrey Kilborn CFO to lead capital markets engagement and support commercialization of its IronCAP post-quantum cryptography products, succeeding retiring Brian Stringer.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: A capital-markets-oriented CFO hire suggests small-cap PQC vendors are preparing to raise funds.

insights.claim: Quantum eMotion added Bernard Crotty, former Chairman and CEO of Certicom (elliptic-curve cryptography pioneer acquired by BlackBerry), as independent director effective September 30, 2026.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Adding a director with a crypto-company exit history hints QeM is targeting commercial traction and possibly M&A in quantum-safe security.

insights.claim: RBC created a dedicated quantum strategy team led by new Director of Quantum Dr. Elizabeth Iwasawa, covering application development and cybersecurity.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Large banks formalizing quantum teams is demand-side evidence for quantum and PQC vendors.

insights.claim: RBC launched multi-year partnerships with the University of Waterloo's Institute for Quantum Computing and the University of Toronto to support talent pipelines and PhD fellowships.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Talent scarcity is a bottleneck; corporate fellowships are how banks lock up quantum talent.

insights.claim: Both Quantum eMotion and 01 Quantum are pitching quantum-safe or post-quantum cryptography offerings and strengthening leadership around commercial development.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Security is the nearest-term monetizable quantum segment; watch for contract wins.
